/*selectSellerMpStStockStateList*/
SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE) AS WAREHOUSE_NAME /*물류센터명*/ , CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO /*품목코드*/ , CQ.DESCRIPTION /*품목명*/ , CQ.SPECIFICATION /*규격*/ , CQ.UNIT_MEASURE /*단위*/ , A.TOT_QTY /*총재고량*/ , A.AVAIL_QTY /*가용재고량*/ , A.ALLOC_QTY /*출하재고량*/ , A.MAX_STOCK_QTY /*최대재고량*/ , A.MIN_ORDER_QTY /*최소재고량*/ FROM WMSSTCK A /* 물류센타 재고 */ , ICOMCQDT CQ /* 구매사별 계약서 가격정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND CQ.BUYER = A.WAREHOUSE_CODE AND CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.STDCATLG_ID AND CQ.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND CQ.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND CQ.PROCESS_TYPE = '3'
AND CQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND CQ.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%'
AND CQ.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_specification} || '%'
ORDER BY 1, 2
